verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can take on Linear/Jira tickets and implement features or fix bugs, and Auto-Fix iterates PRs toward merge-ready quality by responding to review comments and CI failures. No cited item explicitly documents the ticket-to-opened-PR handoff as one end-to-end flow, and hands-on reports note extraneous changes beyond the task. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Devin opens a pull request from a tracked issue, an end-to-end issue-to-PR workflow description, and independent corroboration of clean, complete PRs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end

citations.quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs

With Auto-Fix enabled, Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures — creating a closed loop where PRs iterate toward merge-ready quality without you in the loop.
